stories.title: Road closures in Connah’s Quay, Flint and Cilcain among this week’s Flintshire roadworks
stories.summary: Golftyn Lane in Connah’s Quay is among the roads closed in Flintshire this week, with more than 25 sets of roadworks listed across the county. The list, from Flintshire County Council’s roadworks bulletin for the week ending Friday, 23 October, includes closures, temporary traffic lights and stop-go boards. stories.title: North Wales Everton fans changing at Bidston face packed trains after games
stories.summary: Everton fans travelling home to north Wales through Bidston are among those caught up in crowded trains after evening and Sunday matches, according to a supporter calling for more frequent services. Season ticket holder Alan Runswick wants Merseyrail to run Wirral Line trains every 15 minutes after all Everton games, instead of every 30 minutes.

stories.title: Deeside bike shop beats six UK rivals to Independent Bike Dealer of the Year
stories.summary: A Queensferry bike shop has been named the UK’s Independent Bike Dealer of the Year. The Cycle Hub, on Interlinq Trade Park, won the award at the BikeBiz Awards ceremony in Birmingham on 15 October. stories.title: Charity walk held in memory of Red Hall landlord Gary Powell
